title: GAO/IMTEC-92-26 Patriot Missile Defense: Software Problem Led to System Failure at Dhahran, Saudi Arabia
summary: U.S. GAO report on the Patriot missile defense system's failure to track and intercept a Scud at Dhahran on February 25, 1991.

source_payload.copyability: not embedded in this revision; linked and line-located only
extraction_notes: The report states that the Dhahran battery failed to track and intercept the Scud because of a software problem in the weapons control computer.
The time/precision problem made the tracking calculation less accurate the longer the system had operated.

The report records that the system had operated for more than 100 hours, that Israeli data showed range-gate shift after 8 hours, and that modified software reached Dhahran the day after the incident.

handling_notes: Fatality case; do not name victims unless a future source and ethical rationale require it.
Keep focus on system behavior, evidence, and lessons rather than spectacle.
